close_reason: from_cert now has explicit fail-open/fail-closed rustdoc
description: TrustAnchor::from_cert silently treats a malformed NameConstraints DER value as absent (name_constraints = None), which is fail-open: an anchor with a corrupt NC extension gets no constraints applied. This behavior is tested in anchor_nc.rs test 5, and mentioned in the field-level doc comment, but from_cert has no function-level doc warning about this. A future contributor refactoring find_cert_ext to propagate errors could accidentally change from_cert to fail-closed, breaking the invariant that from_cert is infallible.
title: from_cert fail-open for malformed NC not documented at function level
